scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n client,server "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.mobile:check: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint
